senses.gloss:
अभक्त 1. अ-भक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, unbelieving,
not devoted, not worshipping; not attached to, de-
tached, unconnected with; not accepted.
अभक्त 2. अ-भक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, not eaten.

अ-भक्ति, इस्, f. want of devotion to, want of faith,
unbelief, incredulity.
—अभक्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
undevoted to, unbelieving.

—अ-भक्त-च्छन्दस्, अस्, n. or अ-भक्त-रुच्,
क्, f. want of appetite.

अभक्ष अ-भक्ष, अस्, m. or अ-भक्षण,
अम्, n. not eating anything, fasting.

अ-भक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be eaten.
—अ-
भक्ष्य-भक्षण, अम्, n. eating of prohibited
food.
—अभक्ष्य-भक्षिन्, ईम्, इणी, इ, eating for-
bidden food.

अभग अ-भग, अस्, आ, अम्, without enjoy-
ment, unfortunate.

अभाग अ-भाग, अस्, आ, अम् or अ-भागिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, not sharing or dividing.

आ-भग, अस्, m., Ved. a partaker of (with loc.);
(Sāy.) to be shared in.

अभग्न अ-भग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, unbroken,
entire; uniterrupted.

अ-भङ्गुर, अस्, आ, अम्, unbroken; firm; un-
disturbed.

अ-भज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, not being detached,
associated, attended with.

अभद्र अ-भद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, not good, bad,
wicked; (अम्), n. badness, sin, wickedness.

अभय अ-भय, अस्, आ, अम्, unfearful, not
dangerous, secure; fearless, undaunted; (अस्), m., N.
of Śiva; a son of Dharma; (आ), f. a plant, Termi-
nalia Citrina; (अम्), n, absence or removal of fear,
peace, safety, security; N. of a sacrificial hymn; the
root of a fragrant grass, Andropogon Muricatum.
—अभय-गिरि-वासिन्, ई, m. dwelling on the moun-
tain of safety; N. of a division of Kātyāyana's pupils.
—अभय-गिरि-विहार, अस्, m. Buddhist monastery
on the Abhayagiri.
—अभयङ्-कर, अस्, आ, अम्,
or अभयङ्-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing peace of safety.
—अभय-जात, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—अभय-
डिण्डिम, अस्, m. a war-drum.
—अ-भय-द or
अभयन्-दद or अभयम्-प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्,
giving fearlessness or safety; (अस्), m. an Arhat of
the Jainas; N. of a king, the son of Manusyu and
father of Su-dhanvan.
—अभय-दक्षिणा, f. promise
or present of protection from danger; a gift to a
Brāhman, which he may receive even from a Śūdra.

—अभय-दान or अभय-प्रदान, अम्, n. giv-
ing assurance of safety or protection.
—अभय-
पत्त्र, अम्, n. (a modern term), a written document
or paper granting assurance of safety, a safe conduct.
—अभय-वचन, अम्, n. or अभय-वाच्, क्, f.
assurance of safety, encouragement.
—अभय-सनि,
इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. giving safety.
—अभयानन्द (˚य-
आन्˚), अस्, m., N. of a man.

अभर्तृका अ-भर्तृका, f. an unmarried wo-
man; a widow.

अभव अ-भव, अस्, m. non-existence; de-
struction, end of the world.

अभाव अ-भाव, अस्, m. non-existence, ab-
sence; non-entity, negation, nullity, the seventh cate-
gory in Kaṇāda's system; annihilation, death.

अ-भवनीय or अ-भवितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, what
is not to be, what will not be.

अ-भावनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be inferred or
contemplated, inconceivable.

अ-भवन्-मत-योग or अ-भवन्-मत-सम्-
बन्ध, अस्, m. (in rhetoric) a defect in composition;
want of harmony between the ideas, which are to be
expressed, and the words by which they are expressed.

अ-भव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be, not predestined;
what ought not to be, improper, inauspicious.
अभस्त्र अ-भस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, without bellows.

अ-भस्त्रका or अ-भस्त्रिका or अ-भस्त्राका, f.
a badly made or inferior pair of bellows. The former
two are said to mean also, ‘a small woman who has
no bellows.’
अ-भाग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unfortunate, wretched.

अ-भावना, अम्, f. n. absence of judgment or
right perception; absence of religious meditation or
contemplation.

अ-भावयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, not perceiving, not
inferring, not comprehending.

अ-भाविन्, ई, इनी, इ or अ-भाव्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
what is not to be or will not be, not destined to be.

अभाषण अ-भाषण, अम्, n. not speaking,
silence.
आ-भाषण, अम्, n. addressing, speaking to.

आभज् आ-भज्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -भजति, -भक्-
तुम्, to make one share, cause one to partake.

आभरण आ-भरण, अम्, n. See under
आ-भृ.

आ-भरण, अम्, n. ornament, decoration (as jewels
&c.); act of nourishing; title of several works.

आभा 1. आ-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -तुम्, to
shine, blaze; to irradiate; to outshine; to appear, to
look like.

2. आ-भा, f. splendor, light; a flash; colour, appear-
ance, beauty; a reflected image, shade; likeness,
resemblance: (अस्, आ, अम्, at the end of compounds)
[]
like, resembling, appearing; e. g. हेमाभ, अस्, आ,
अम्, shining like gold; [cf. Hib. aoibh, ‘likeness,
similitude;’ aoibe, ‘neatness, elegance;’ aoibheal,
‘a spark of fire.’]
आ-भाति, इस्, f. splendor, light; shade.

आभाष् आ-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भाषते, -षितुम्,
to address, speak to; to talk, shout.

आभास् 1. आ-भास्, cl. 1. A. -भासते, -सितुम्,
to shine, blaze; to be bright: Caus. -भासयति,
-यितुम्, to illuminate.
2. आ-भास्, f. splendor, lustre, light.
आ-भाष, अस्, m. addressing; introduction, preface.

आ-भास, अस्, m. splendor, light, colour, appear-
ance; semblance, phantom; mere appearance; falla-
cious appearance; reflection; intention, purpose; (in
logic) fallacy, semblance of a reason, sophism, an erro-
neous though plausible argument (regarded by logi-
cians as of various kinds).

1. आ-भाष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be addressed, worthy
of being spoken to.

2. आ-भाष्य, ind. having addressed, having
spoken to.

आ-भासन, अम्, n. illuminating, making apparent
or clear.

आ-भासुर, अस्, m., N. of a class of deities or demi-
gods, sixty in number.

आ-भास्वर, अस्, m. a demi-god, of a class consist-
ing of sixty-four.

आ-भरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing.
—आभरद्-
वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. bringing property, goods, &c.;
(उस्), m., N. of a man.
आ-भरित, अस्, आ, अम्, ornamented, adorned.
